blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Validation — 驗證
blocks.en: Validation

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 驗證三要素
blocks.en: The Three Elements of Validation

blocks.zh: USP 要求的除菌過濾驗證必須回答三個問題：
blocks.en: The sterilizing filtration validation required by USP must answer three questions:

blocks.zh: 液體對濾膜的影響 — 相容性測試（Compatibility）：藥液是否會溶解、膨脹或損壞膜材？
blocks.en: Effect of the liquid on the filter - compatibility testing: will the drug solution dissolve, swell, or damage the membrane material?

blocks.zh: 濾膜對液體的影響 — 可萃取物/浸出物（Extractables/Leachables）：濾膜是否會釋放物質到藥液中？
blocks.en: Effect of the filter on the liquid - extractables/leachables: will the filter release substances into the drug solution?

blocks.zh: 微生物截留能力 — 細菌挑戰測試（Bacterial Challenge）：在製程條件下能否持續產生無菌濾出液？
blocks.en: Microbial retention capability - bacterial challenge: can the filter consistently produce a sterile filtrate under process conditions?

blocks.zh: B. diminuta 不存活時的三種替代方案
blocks.en: Three Alternatives When B. diminuta Does Not Survive

blocks.zh: 許多生物製劑（特別是含防腐劑或極端 pH 的產品）會殺死 B. diminuta。USP 提供三種解決方案，在 CDMO 環境中的選擇優先順序：
blocks.en: Many biologics (especially products containing preservatives or with extreme pH) kill B. diminuta. USP offers three solutions; their order of preference in a CDMO setting is:

blocks.zh: 修改液體（最常用） — 調整 pH 或去除殺菌成分，使 B. diminuta 存活。需科學合理化
blocks.en: Modify the liquid (most common) - adjust the pH or remove the bactericidal component so that B. diminuta survives. Requires scientific justification

blocks.zh: 縮短暴露時間 — 減少挑戰菌與藥液接觸時間
blocks.en: Shorten the exposure time - reduce the contact time between the challenge organism and the drug solution

blocks.zh: 更換挑戰菌（最後手段） — 使用從藥液中分離的微生物作為替代挑戰菌
blocks.en: Change the challenge organism (last resort) - use a microorganism isolated from the drug solution as the surrogate challenge organism

blocks.zh: PDA TR26 對這些替代方案有更詳細的指導，應交叉參考。
blocks.en: PDA TR26 gives more detailed guidance on these alternatives and should be cross-referenced.

blocks.zh: 三批次 + 邊界規格
blocks.en: Three Lots + Boundary Specifications

blocks.zh: 3 lots of filter membranes：USP 要求使用三個不同批次的濾膜進行驗證，且這些濾膜的完整性測試值應接近（near）供應商規格下限。這個「near」非常關鍵 — 它確保驗證結果代表「最差情況」（worst-case），而非「最佳情況」。
blocks.en: 3 lots of filter membranes: USP requires validation with three different lots of filter membranes, and the integrity test values of these filters should be near the supplier's lower specification limit. The word "near" is critical - it ensures that the validation result represents the "worst case" rather than the "best case".

blocks.zh: 47-mm disk 驗證膜材本身的截留能力，成本低，操作簡便
blocks.en: A 47-mm disk validates the retention capability of the membrane material itself; it is low-cost and easy to handle

blocks.zh: 10-inch cartridge 驗證完整系統（含密封、褶皺、支撐層），更接近實際製程
blocks.en: A 10-inch cartridge validates the complete system (including seals, pleats, and support layers) and is closer to the actual process

blocks.zh: CDMO 最佳實務：先用 disk 確認膜材適用性，再用 cartridge 確認系統性能
blocks.en: CDMO best practice: first use disks to confirm the suitability of the membrane material, then use cartridges to confirm system performance

blocks.zh: 濾膜滅菌 — 必須在殼體內
blocks.en: Filter Sterilization - Must Be Done in the Housing

blocks.zh: USP 明確要求濾膜應在殼體（housing）內進行滅菌，而非分開滅菌後無菌組裝。這是因為：
blocks.en: USP explicitly requires that the filter be sterilized in its housing, rather than sterilized separately and then assembled aseptically. This is because:

blocks.zh: 無菌組裝存在污染風險
blocks.en: Aseptic assembly carries a contamination risk

blocks.zh: 濾芯安裝密封的確認更可靠
blocks.en: Confirmation of the cartridge installation and sealing is more reliable

blocks.zh: SIP（Steam-In-Place）是 CDMO 環境中的標準做法
blocks.en: SIP (steam-in-place) is the standard practice in CDMO environments

blocks.zh: Integrity Testing Principles and Methods — 完整性測試原理與方法
blocks.en: Integrity Testing Principles and Methods

blocks.zh: 完整性測試的三重目的
blocks.en: The Three Purposes of Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: USP 將完整性測試的價值歸納為三項確認：
blocks.en: USP summarizes the value of integrity testing as three confirmations:

blocks.zh: 正確的孔徑等級 — 確認安裝的確實是 0.2 µm 而非 0.45 µm
blocks.en: Correct pore size rating - confirms that the installed filter is indeed 0.2 µm and not 0.45 µm

blocks.zh: 正確安裝 — 確認 O-ring 密封完好、濾芯就位
blocks.en: Correct installation - confirms that the O-ring seals are intact and the cartridge is properly seated

blocks.zh: 未被滅菌損壞 — 確認 SIP 或 autoclave 未破壞濾膜結構
blocks.en: Not damaged by sterilization - confirms that SIP or autoclaving has not damaged the membrane structure

blocks.zh: 核心原理：所有方法都基於偵測氣體穿過潤濕（wetted）濾膜的行為。潤濕是前提 — 乾燥的濾膜無法進行有效的完整性測試。
blocks.en: Core principle: all methods are based on detecting the behavior of gas passing through a wetted filter membrane. Wetting is a prerequisite - a dry filter cannot be integrity tested effectively.

blocks.zh: Bubble Point — 泡點測試
blocks.en: Bubble Point

blocks.zh: 泡點公式解析
blocks.en: The Bubble Point Equation

blocks.zh:
P = 4γcosΘ / D

關鍵關係：
  孔徑 D 越小 → 泡點壓力 P 越高
  表面張力 γ 越高 → 泡點壓力 P 越高
  潤濕角 Θ 越小（越親水）→ cosΘ 越大 → P 越高
blocks.en:
P = 4γcosΘ / D

Key relationships:
  Smaller pore diameter D → higher bubble point pressure P
  Higher surface tension γ → higher bubble point pressure P
  Smaller wetting angle Θ (more hydrophilic) → larger cosΘ → higher P

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 0.2 µm 濾膜的泡點高於 0.45 µm — 孔徑小，需要更高壓力才能將潤濕液從孔隙中排出。
blocks.en: This is why the bubble point of a 0.2 µm filter is higher than that of a 0.45 µm filter - with smaller pores, a higher pressure is needed to expel the wetting liquid from the pores.

blocks.zh: 泡點測試的限制
blocks.en: Limitations of the Bubble Point Test

blocks.zh: 大面積濾膜的難題：在多支濾芯組合的大面積過濾系統中，大量的擴散流（diffusive flow）會遮蔽真正的泡點轉折。這就是為什麼大系統通常使用擴散流測試而非泡點測試。
blocks.en: The difficulty of large membrane areas: in large-area filtration systems made up of multiple cartridges, the large amount of diffusive flow masks the true bubble point inflection. This is why large systems usually use the diffusive flow test rather than the bubble point test.

blocks.zh: 手動 vs. 自動：手動泡點測試需要觀察下游側的氣泡，具主觀性且需要操作下游管路（增加污染風險）。現代 CDMO 幾乎全面使用自動完整性測試儀（如 Sartorius Sartocheck, Pall Palltronic）。
blocks.en: Manual vs. automated: manual bubble point testing requires observing bubbles on the downstream side, which is subjective and requires handling the downstream piping (increasing contamination risk). Modern CDMOs almost universally use automated integrity testers (such as Sartorius Sartocheck and Pall Palltronic).

blocks.zh: Diffusive Flow — 擴散流測試
blocks.en: Diffusive Flow

blocks.zh: Fick's Law 應用
blocks.en: Application of Fick's Law

blocks.zh:
N = [D × H × ΔP] / (L × ρ)

擴散流量正比於：
  ΔP（測試壓力） ↑  → 流量 ↑
  過濾面積 ↑        → 流量 ↑

擴散流量反比於：
  液層厚度 L ↑      → 流量 ↓

有缺陷的孔隙 → 液層變薄 → 局部擴散流增大 → 可偵測
blocks.en:
N = [D × H × ΔP] / (L × ρ)

Diffusive flow is proportional to:
  ΔP (test pressure) ↑  → flow ↑
  Filtration area ↑      → flow ↑

Diffusive flow is inversely proportional to:
  Liquid layer thickness L ↑  → flow ↓

Defective pore → thinner liquid layer → higher local diffusive flow → detectable

blocks.zh: 溫度敏感性的實務影響
blocks.en: Practical Impact of Temperature Sensitivity

blocks.zh: 擴散流測試對溫度非常敏感。在 CDMO 環境中，SIP 後的濾膜溫度可能尚未完全降至環境溫度。若在濾膜仍偏熱時進行測試，擴散流會偏高，可能導致假失敗（false failure）。最佳實務是確保測試前濾膜溫度穩定至 ±2°C 以內。
blocks.en: The diffusive flow test is very sensitive to temperature. In a CDMO setting, the filter temperature after SIP may not yet have fully dropped to ambient temperature. If the test is performed while the filter is still warm, the diffusive flow will read high and may cause a false failure. Best practice is to ensure the filter temperature is stable within ±2°C before testing.

blocks.zh: Pressure Hold — 壓力保持測試
blocks.en: Pressure Hold

blocks.zh: 壓力保持公式解析
blocks.en: The Pressure Hold Equation

blocks.zh:
Df = [(p1 × Vu) / (p0 × t)] × ln[p1/(p1 - Δp)]

關鍵變數：
  Vu = 上游體積（必須準確量測）
  t = 測試時間（通常 5-10 分鐘）
  Δp = 壓降值 — 越小越好
blocks.en:
Df = [(p1 × Vu) / (p0 × t)] × ln[p1/(p1 - Δp)]

Key variables:
  Vu = upstream volume (must be measured accurately)
  t = test time (typically 5-10 minutes)
  Δp = pressure drop - the smaller the better

blocks.zh: 壓力保持測試的本質是把擴散流轉換為壓降來量測 — 不需要在下游側量測流量，降低了操作複雜度和污染風險。
blocks.en: The essence of the pressure hold test is converting diffusive flow into a pressure drop for measurement - no flow measurement is needed on the downstream side, which reduces operational complexity and contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 壓力保持測試的獨特優勢
blocks.en: Unique Advantages of the Pressure Hold Test

blocks.zh: 相較於直接擴散流測試，壓力保持測試有兩個關鍵優勢：
blocks.en: Compared with the direct diffusive flow test, the pressure hold test has two key advantages:

blocks.zh: 偵測組裝缺陷：除了濾膜本身，還能偵測殼體密封、O-ring 損壞、濾芯未正確就位等問題
blocks.en: Detects assembly defects: beyond the membrane itself, it can also detect problems such as housing seals, damaged O-rings, and cartridges that are not properly seated

blocks.zh: 避免下游操作：無需在下游側連接流量計，減少對已滅菌下游管路的干預 — 這在 PUPSIT 場景中尤為重要
blocks.en: Avoids downstream operations: no flow meter needs to be connected on the downstream side, reducing intervention on the sterilized downstream piping - which is especially important in PUPSIT scenarios

blocks.zh: 三種測試方法總結比較
blocks.en: Comparison of the Three Test Methods

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 灌裝環境中，壓力保持和擴散流是最常用的方法，通常由自動完整性測試儀執行。
blocks.en: In CDMO filling environments, pressure hold and diffusive flow are the most commonly used methods, and are usually performed by automated integrity testers.

blocks.zh: When to Test Integrity — 完整性測試時機（PUPSIT 議題）
blocks.en: When to Test Integrity (the PUPSIT Issue)

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 辯論 — 業界最熱門的爭議之一
blocks.en: The PUPSIT Debate - One of the Hottest Controversies in the Industry

blocks.zh: PUPSIT（Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test）是除菌過濾領域中爭議最大的話題：
blocks.en: PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilization integrity test) is the most controversial topic in the field of sterilizing filtration:

blocks.zh: CDMO 的實務策略
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Strategy

blocks.zh: USP 的立場偏保守（可以不做 PUPSIT），但 EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) 明確要求 PUPSIT。作為服務全球客戶的 CDMO：
blocks.en: USP's position is relatively conservative (PUPSIT may be omitted), but EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) explicitly requires PUPSIT. As a CDMO serving global clients:

blocks.zh: 歐洲市場產品：必須執行 PUPSIT，或提供科學合理的替代方案並獲得稽查機構認可
blocks.en: Products for the European market: PUPSIT must be performed, or a scientifically justified alternative must be provided and accepted by the inspectorate

blocks.zh: 美國市場產品：可基於風險評估決定是否執行，但後過濾完整性測試（post-use）是不可或缺的
blocks.en: Products for the US market: whether to perform it can be decided based on a risk assessment, but the post-use integrity test is indispensable

blocks.zh: 最佳實務：許多 CDMO 選擇全面實施 PUPSIT，使用自動化測試儀最小化操作風險，以滿足最嚴格的法規要求
blocks.en: Best practice: many CDMOs choose to implement PUPSIT across the board, using automated testers to minimize operational risk, in order to meet the most stringent regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: PDA TR26 對 PUPSIT 有更深入的討論，應交叉參考。
blocks.en: PDA TR26 discusses PUPSIT in more depth and should be cross-referenced.

blocks.zh: 後過濾完整性測試 — 唯一的「必須」
blocks.en: Post-use Integrity Testing - the Only "Must"

blocks.zh: 無論對 PUPSIT 持何種立場，USP 明確要求後過濾完整性測試（post-use integrity test）是必須執行的。這是回溯性確認：在整個過濾過程中，濾膜始終保持完整。如果後過濾測試失敗，該批次的無菌性即受到質疑，通常需要進行偏差調查。
blocks.en: Whatever one's position on PUPSIT, USP explicitly states that the post-use integrity test must be performed. It is a retrospective confirmation that the filter remained intact throughout the entire filtration process. If the post-use test fails, the sterility of the batch is called into question, and a deviation investigation is usually required.

blocks.zh: Prefiltration Bioburden Control — 前過濾生物負載控制
blocks.en: Prefiltration Bioburden Control

blocks.zh: 冗餘過濾（Redundant Filtration）在 CDMO 中的實務
blocks.en: Redundant Filtration in CDMO Practice

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) 強烈建議在最終除菌過濾前設置冗餘過濾。在 CDMO 環境中：
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) strongly recommends redundant filtration ahead of the final sterilizing filtration. In a CDMO setting:

blocks.zh: 標準配置：上游 0.2 µm 或 0.45 µm 前過濾 + 最終 0.2 µm 除菌過濾
blocks.en: Standard configuration: an upstream 0.2 µm or 0.45 µm prefilter + a final 0.2 µm sterilizing filter

blocks.zh: 前過濾的目的：降低最終濾膜的生物負載和微粒負擔，延長使用壽命，降低堵塞風險
blocks.en: Purpose of the prefilter: to reduce the bioburden and particulate load on the final filter, extend its service life, and lower the risk of clogging

blocks.zh: 前過濾也需要完整性測試嗎？如果前過濾是除菌級（0.2 µm），則需要。如果是非除菌級（如 0.45 µm bioburden reduction filter），通常不需要，但應有其他控制措施
blocks.en: Does the prefilter also need integrity testing? If the prefilter is sterilizing-grade (0.2 µm), yes. If it is not sterilizing-grade (e.g., a 0.45 µm bioburden reduction filter), it is usually not required, but other controls should be in place

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 機場安檢的多層概念：冗餘過濾就像機場安檢的多重關卡 — 行李 X 光（前過濾）在旅客到達金屬探測門（最終除菌過濾）之前就已經攔截了大部分違禁品。這不是因為金屬探測門不可靠，而是為了確保它不會被過多的「挑戰」所淹沒。
blocks.en: The multi-layer concept of airport security: redundant filtration is like the multiple checkpoints at airport security - the baggage X-ray (prefilter) intercepts most prohibited items before the passenger reaches the metal detector gate (final sterilizing filter). This is not because the metal detector is unreliable, but to make sure it is not overwhelmed by too much "challenge".

blocks.zh: Responsibilities — 職責分工
blocks.en: Responsibilities

blocks.zh: CDMO 的關鍵注意事項
blocks.en: Key Considerations for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你既是「濾膜使用者」（Filter User），也承擔著為客戶產品驗證過濾製程的責任。這意味著：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, you are both the "filter user" and responsible for validating the filtration process for the client's product. This means:

blocks.zh: 供應商管理：需建立合格供應商清單（AVL），定期審計濾膜供應商的品質系統
blocks.en: Supplier management: establish an approved vendor list (AVL) and periodically audit the quality systems of filter suppliers

blocks.zh: 產品專屬驗證：每個客戶產品都可能需要獨立的細菌截留驗證（BRV）— 不同配方可能對濾膜產生不同影響
blocks.en: Product-specific validation: each client product may need its own bacterial retention validation (BRV) - different formulations may affect the filter differently

blocks.zh: Extractables/Leachables 分界：供應商提供的是「可萃取物」（extractables）數據 — 使用標準溶劑的worst-case 數據。使用者需要的是「浸出物」（leachables）數據 — 實際藥液接觸後的數據
blocks.en: Extractables/leachables boundary: the supplier provides "extractables" data - worst-case data obtained with standard solvents. The user needs "leachables" data - data obtained after contact with the actual drug solution

blocks.zh: Troubleshooting — 疑難排解
blocks.en: Troubleshooting

blocks.zh: 完整性測試失敗的排查流程
blocks.en: Investigation Flow for Integrity Test Failures

blocks.zh: USP 提供了一個系統性的排查邏輯，CDMO 應建立對應的 SOP：
blocks.en: USP provides a systematic troubleshooting logic, and a CDMO should establish a corresponding SOP:

blocks.zh: Step 1 — 確認測試條件：設備校準？測試參數正確？溫度穩定？
blocks.en: Step 1 - Confirm test conditions: Is the equipment calibrated? Are the test parameters correct? Is the temperature stable?

blocks.zh: Step 2 — 確認潤濕：濾膜是否完全潤濕？沖洗量是否足夠？
blocks.en: Step 2 - Confirm wetting: Is the filter fully wetted? Is the flush volume sufficient?

blocks.zh: Step 3 — 確認系統密封：殼體密封？管線無洩漏？
blocks.en: Step 3 - Confirm system sealing: Is the housing sealed? Are the lines free of leaks?

blocks.zh: Step 4 — 重新潤濕並重測：增加沖洗時間、體積和壓差
blocks.en: Step 4 - Rewet and retest: increase flush time, volume, and differential pressure

blocks.zh: Step 5 — 使用參考液：改用低表面張力液體（如 70% IPA）重測
blocks.en: Step 5 - Use a reference liquid: retest with a low-surface-tension liquid (such as 70% IPA)

blocks.zh: Step 6 — 判定不合格：若參考液測試仍失敗，則濾膜確認為不合格
blocks.en: Step 6 - Declare failure: if the test with the reference liquid still fails, the filter is confirmed as non-conforming

blocks.zh: Step 7 — 根本原因分析：可將濾膜退回供應商進行完整分析
blocks.en: Step 7 - Root cause analysis: the filter can be returned to the supplier for a full analysis

blocks.zh: 潤濕不完全 — 最常見的假失敗原因
blocks.en: Incomplete Wetting - the Most Common Cause of False Failures

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 日常操作中，完整性測試失敗最常見的原因是濾膜潤濕不完全，特別是：
blocks.en: In day-to-day CDMO operations, the most common cause of integrity test failure is incomplete wetting of the filter, especially:

blocks.zh: 疏水性膜材（如 PVDF）需要更長的潤濕時間
blocks.en: Hydrophobic membrane materials (such as PVDF) need a longer wetting time

blocks.zh: SIP 後殘留的蒸汽可能造成局部乾燥
blocks.en: Residual steam after SIP may cause local drying

blocks.zh: 大型多支濾芯系統中，部分濾芯可能未均勻潤濕
blocks.en: In large multi-cartridge systems, some cartridges may not be wetted uniformly

blocks.zh: 建立標準化的潤濕程序（包括最小沖洗量和流速）是預防假失敗的最有效措施。
blocks.en: Establishing a standardized wetting procedure (including minimum flush volume and flow rate) is the most effective measure to prevent false failures.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點回顧
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 驗證三要素：液體對濾膜的影響 + 濾膜對液體的影響 + 微生物截留能力。必須使用實際產品液、3 批濾膜、製程條件
blocks.en: Three elements of validation: effect of the liquid on the filter + effect of the filter on the liquid + microbial retention capability. The actual product fluid, 3 lots of filters, and process conditions must be used

blocks.zh: 三種完整性測試方法：泡點（最大孔隙）、擴散流（Fick's Law 總擴散）、壓力保持（壓降換算）— 各有適用場景
blocks.en: Three integrity test methods: bubble point (largest pore), diffusive flow (total diffusion per Fick's Law), and pressure hold (pressure-drop conversion) - each has its own suitable applications

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 爭議：USP 允許基於風險評估省略 PUPSIT；EU GMP Annex 1 要求執行。CDMO 應以最嚴格標準為基準
blocks.en: The PUPSIT controversy: USP allows PUPSIT to be omitted based on a risk assessment; EU GMP Annex 1 requires it. A CDMO should use the strictest standard as its baseline

blocks.zh: 後過濾完整性測試：唯一不可省略的測試 — 回溯性確認過濾期間濾膜始終完整
blocks.en: Post-use integrity test: the only test that cannot be omitted - a retrospective confirmation that the filter remained intact during filtration

blocks.zh: 前過濾控制：冗餘過濾（串聯或時間分隔）降低最終濾膜的負擔；生物負載穩定低時可用單一濾膜
blocks.en: Prefiltration control: redundant filtration (in series or separated in time) reduces the burden on the final filter; a single filter may be used when bioburden is consistently low

blocks.zh: 職責分界：供應商負責 ASTM F838、完整性規格、可萃取物；使用者負責產品專屬驗證、浸出物、製程驗證
blocks.en: Division of responsibilities: the supplier is responsible for ASTM F838, integrity specifications, and extractables; the user is responsible for product-specific validation, leachables, and process validation

blocks.zh: 排查邏輯：潤濕不完全是最常見的假失敗原因 — 系統性排查後若使用參考液仍失敗，則判定不合格
blocks.en: Troubleshooting logic: incomplete wetting is the most common cause of false failures - after systematic troubleshooting, if the test with a reference liquid still fails, the filter is declared non-conforming

blocks.zh: Cross-reference：PDA TR26 提供更詳細的驗證方法論和 PUPSIT 討論；EU GMP Annex 1 提供法規要求
blocks.en: Cross-reference: PDA TR26 provides more detailed validation methodology and PUPSIT discussion; EU GMP Annex 1 provides the regulatory requirements
